review.rationale: The validator comment and visible validation error declare an exact ASCII name language. MCP stdio integration creation calls this validation before persistence; later saved configuration is passed to StdioTransport. CPython `$` accepts a final-line-feed suffix outside the declared language, reproduced against the exact pinned validator. This is a configuration-validation gap only; security impact is not established.
limitations: This is a one-site targeted source review, not a complete Tracecat review; the exact-pin inventory has 115 Tracecat rows.
The claim is limited to Tracecat's declared syntax, not universal POSIX conformance.
The proof domain is ASCII keys of length 1..64; Unicode keys and other configuration semantics are outside the theorem.
No command injection, privilege escalation, deployed-server behavior, or security impact is claimed.
